sections.heading: Request
paragraphs: Exception SE-091 permits one isolated Rotterdam lab gateway to run firmware 2.7.6 through 15 November while the hardware team reproduces a serial-port fault.

sections.heading: Controls
paragraphs: Keep the gateway on the lab VLAN, use the test certificate authority, and block external telemetry. The device must carry a red exception tag with its owner and expiry.

sections.heading: Closure
paragraphs: Replace the lab image after reproducing the fault. Hardware Operations verifies that the gateway can enroll with the supported firmware before the exception is closed.
